[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for cooking quinoa perfectly:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Rinse quinoa to remove saponin.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Use a 2:1 ratio of water to quinoa.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Soaking is optional but rinse again if soaked.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Cook on medium heat.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Don't overcook; it should be tender but slightly
